name: MCP Router
description: A centralized gateway platform for aggregating and managing multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers through a single Electron-based interface. It provides enterprise-grade security features including policy-based access control, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, and comprehensive audit logging.
